name: IG30CDS Conductivity Sensor
shortDescription: Measure conductivity in water treatment and industrial process water with a choice of cell constants. Digital communication and stored calibration settings support system integration and routine operation, while the supplied mounting arrangement and flow cell simplify installation.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Fast response time, reaching 95% in 15 seconds
◆ Digital sensor, RS-485 output, standard Modbus RTU protocol, not affected by transmission distance, better stability
◆ The sensor is made of Ryton material, which has a longer service life and reduces maintenance and downtime
◆ Quick response, accurate measurement, reliable data, and convenient operation
◆ Internal electrodes can measure extremely weak signals without polarization effects
◆ Internal integrated memory, can still remember the calibration and setting information stored even after power failure
Application areas:
Surface water, municipal sewage, environmental monitoring, industrial process control, pollution sources, industrial wastewater, tap water, biopharmaceuticals, beer and beverage, petroleum and petrochemical, metallurgy
Technical parameters:
Measurement range: K=0.01，0-20us/cm； K=0. 1，0-200us/cm;  K=1，0-2000us/cm;  K=10，0-20000us/cm
Temperature: 0-125 ℃
Resolution: 0.01 us/cm; 0.1us/cm;  1us/cm，0.1℃
Accuracy: ± 1% reading
Repeatability: ± 1% reading
Temperature compensation: automatic
Working environment: 0-95 ℃
Maximum pressure: 6.0bar
Maximum flow velocity: 3 meters per second
Calibration method: Standard solution calibration
Temperature compensation: automatic
Temperature electrode: PT1000
Electrode form: digital electrode
Response time: 15 seconds up to 95%
Communication interface: ModbusRS485
Electrode material: PEEK、Ryton
Threaded interface: Front and rear standard 3/4NPT
Protection level: IP68
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Electrode size: 165mm * 25mm
